summary: All existing covenants remain appropriate given the evidence of timely reporting, no material adverse effect, successful VIP acquisition, and EBITDA performance meeting contingent‑note thresholds; no new protections are warranted.

clauses.rationale: Evidence shows 2018 adjusted EBITDA of $41.5 m, exceeding the $40 m threshold, indicating the leverage covenant is not stressed.
FY 2018 results were released on 2019‑03‑11, within the 90‑day annual reporting window.
Quarterly releases for Q1‑Q3 2018 appeared within 45 days of quarter‑end, satisfying the quarterly reporting requirement.
No evidence of missed monthly statement deadlines; the current monthly reporting frequency remains adequate.
Press releases show strong growth and no reported defaults or material adverse effects, supporting the existing notice period.
The company’s use of the $75 m revolving facility and contingent notes aligns with the permitted indebtedness baskets; no overruns observed.

drift_reasons: Available evidence does not show any deterioration in financial reporting, adverse events, acquisition performance, or EBITDA‑linked contingent‑note triggers that would justify tightening, loosening, or adding covenants.
